top_signals.title: Gold Holds Drop as Higher Oil and Hot US Data Fan Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold held a decline as resurgent energy prices and stronger-than-expected US economic data increased bets the Federal Reserve might again raise interest rates to combat inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China’s Ban on Overseas Coal Plants Stumbles in Indonesia: CREA
top_signals.summary: China has scrapped two-thirds of its planned overseas coal projects since President Xi Jinping pledged five years ago to stop building plants abroad, while stepping up the development of green energy in the Global South.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US and China agree to extend trade truce until January: Bessent
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Steam catapults? US Navy appears to be sticking with electromagnetics on carriers
top_signals.summary: Despite an August order for the U.S. Navy to return to steam catapults on its newest carriers, the service appears to be sticking with electromagnetics.

top_signals.title: Royal Navy successfully launches US Mk 48 torpedo from uncrewed submersible
top_signals.summary: Last week, the Royal Navy successfully launched a U.S.-made Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo from a British Excalibur uncrewed underwater vehicle.
